name: com.smileidentity.libsmileid.core.consent.bvn.ui.activities.ConsentBVNContactMethodActivity
description: During Smile Identity's Nigerian BVN consent flow, this screen shows the contact methods offered for the entered number and sends the selected method to the verification service before OTP confirmation.
disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot choose where to receive a code, so BVN consent cannot continue.
